tutorial.step.welcome.title: Your dashboard
tutorial.step.welcome.body: See dates, homework, grades and personal reminders in chronological order.
tutorial.step.holidays.title: Holidays
tutorial.step.holidays.body: The card shows remaining days and progress. Tap it to open the relevant calendar week.
tutorial.step.deadlines.title: Grade deadlines
tutorial.step.deadlines.body: Tap the card to change dates. You can set one or two deadlines; your choice is stored locally.
tutorial.step.filter.title: Dashboard filter
tutorial.step.filter.body: Open the filter to show or hide grades/tests, homework, observations and empty days.
tutorial.step.past.title: Past entries
tutorial.step.past.body: Switch to the past to review older entries. The same button returns to upcoming items.
tutorial.step.reminders.title: Reminders
tutorial.step.reminders.body: Tap + on the right of a future day, write a reminder, and save it. It is added to your dashboard.
tutorial.step.assessmentShortcuts.title: Tests and exams
tutorial.step.assessmentShortcuts.body: Tap + on the right of a future day. Start the text with /cw for classwork and save it. /test and /exam mark tests and exams. The entry also appears in the exam calendar.
tutorial.step.semester.title: Semester
tutorial.step.semester.body: Switch between first semester, second semester and the full school year.
tutorial.step.gradeHistory.title: Grade history
tutorial.step.gradeHistory.body: Open the history to compare your development between semesters.
tutorial.step.averages.title: Three averages
tutorial.step.averages.body: Overall average, report-card average and forecast show different views of your grades. Info buttons explain the calculation.
tutorial.step.gradeFilters.title: Three filters
tutorial.step.gradeFilters.body: Sort by grade type, show cancelled grades and enable grade colors. A subject filter appears for favorites.
tutorial.step.view.title: Grade view
tutorial.step.view.body: Expand a subject for individual grades, weights and details. Charts and statistics support comparisons.
tutorial.step.absenceLink.title: Absences in grades
tutorial.step.absenceLink.body: The absence badge on a subject shows its count and connects achievement with attendance.
tutorial.step.calculator.title: Grade calculator
tutorial.step.calculator.body: Scroll down if needed and open the calculator yourself. You can calculate with custom values even without grades.
tutorial.step.calculatorImport.title: Import grades
tutorial.step.calculatorImport.body: Use existing grades from a subject and semester as your starting point.
tutorial.step.calculatorAdd.title: Add a grade
tutorial.step.calculatorAdd.body: Add custom grades with a weight. Values can be edited or removed by swiping.
tutorial.step.calculatorTarget.title: Target-grade calculator
tutorial.step.calculatorTarget.body: Find the future grades needed for your desired average, optionally using planned assessments.
tutorial.step.absenceOverview.title: Absence overview
tutorial.step.absenceOverview.body: Find absences, delays, justification status and history here.
tutorial.step.absenceStatistics.title: Statistics and status
tutorial.step.absenceStatistics.body: Metrics, rate and pie chart summarize attendance. Sections can be expanded.
tutorial.step.futureAbsence.title: Record a future absence
tutorial.step.futureAbsence.body: If enabled by your school, enter dates, lessons, reason and signature in advance; entries can be removed again.
tutorial.step.absenceHistory.title: History and justification
tutorial.step.absenceHistory.body: Entries show dates, lessons and status. Open absences can be justified directly when enabled.
tutorial.step.navigation.title: Change weeks
tutorial.step.navigation.body: Use arrows to move by week. Tap the date range to jump directly; Current week returns to today.
tutorial.step.lessons.title: Timetable
tutorial.step.lessons.body: Each column is a school day. Lessons show subject, room, teacher and time; changes are color-coded.
tutorial.step.calendarDetails.title: Day and lesson details
tutorial.step.calendarDetails.body: Tap a lesson or day. Details open beside the calendar on large screens and on a page elsewhere.
tutorial.step.abbreviations.title: Abbreviations
tutorial.step.abbreviations.body: Subject abbreviations keep the timetable compact. Edit them in Settings; favorites filter the calendar.
tutorial.step.substitutions.title: Substitutions
tutorial.step.substitutions.body: Substitutions are marked. The notice bar configures detection and main teachers or reports a wrong substitution.
tutorial.step.calendarFilters.title: Filters and display
tutorial.step.calendarFilters.body: Favorites narrow down subjects; empty days and the calendar display adapt to your view.
tutorial.step.examOverview.title: Exam calendar
tutorial.step.examOverview.body: All appointments created with /test, /cw and /exam are collected here automatically.
tutorial.step.examCards.title: Exam cards
tutorial.step.examCards.body: Cards show date, countdown and study progress. Past exams remain in an expandable history.
tutorial.step.studyPlan.title: Automatic study plan
tutorial.step.studyPlan.body: Recognized assessments get study phases. Check off completed phases and customize them in details.
tutorial.step.examDetails.title: Details and files
tutorial.step.examDetails.body: Open an assessment for phases, material, notes and local file attachments. Local data stays on this device.
tutorial.step.weekView.title: Calendar view
tutorial.step.weekView.body: The week view distributes exams and study phases across seven days; arrows and Today change the period.
tutorial.step.classRegister.title: Class register
tutorial.step.classRegister.body: Find lesson entries, topics, teachers, substitutions and class-related absences.
tutorial.step.materials.title: Materials
tutorial.step.materials.body: Browse course folders and open shared files and learning materials.
tutorial.step.homework.title: Homework
tutorial.step.homework.body: This overview groups assignments by course and period, including details and attachments.
tutorial.step.certificate.title: Report card
tutorial.step.certificate.body: Find published report-card data and assessments here.
tutorial.step.messages.title: Messages
tutorial.step.messages.body: Read school messages, open attachments and respond to confirmation requests.
tutorial.deadlineDialog.title: Set grade deadlines
tutorial.step.calendarEntries.title: Entries and attachments
tutorial.step.calendarEntries.body: The calendar combines lessons with homework, tests and personal exams. Open cards for descriptions, submissions and available file attachments.

privacyDetails.title: What data is collected?
privacySettings.title: Privacy & data
privacyDetails.choice.title: Your choice
privacyDetails.choice.body: You can choose diagnostics, usage analytics and additional school & grade statistics separately. The app works without optional data. A new notice version requires a new decision.
privacyDetails.required.title: Required processing
privacyDetails.required.body: The app communicates with your selected school register, handles authentication and sessions, and stores settings and cached register data locally where applicable. Calendar synchronization and file access provide functions you request. This processing is separate from optional Firebase services.
privacyDetails.crashes.title: Firebase Crashlytics diagnostics
privacyDetails.crashes.body: Only after consent, technical error reports help identify crashes and problems with particular app versions or devices. We do not set a school account identifier.
privacyDetails.automatic.title: Automatic technical crash data
privacyDetails.automatic.body: Depending on the SDK and platform: exception type, technical message, stack trace, time and fatal/non-fatal classification; app package, version and build; OS, device model, CPU architecture, memory/storage information, root/jailbreak, foreground/background and orientation. Technical installation/session identifiers, threads, binary images and native addresses may be included. Native signals and Android NDK crash data are platform-specific. Proximity sensor state may be supplied by the SDK; the app does not read sensors for diagnostics. Available build metadata may help identify builds. Not all fields are available on every platform.
privacyDetails.context.title: Additional technical context
privacyDetails.context.body: Current/previous screen, lifecycle, demo and login status, technical provider category; API version/environment, normalized endpoint, method, status, request type and response format; network availability, connection category where known, retries and timeouts; cache settings/hits and technical storage/migration versions; semester, tab and predefined filter; theme and language; notification availability/category; background task, sync status/result; data source, parser, feature and operation; first launch, detected upgrade and previous app version; installation source, build flavor, release channel, Flutter/Dart versions and backend reachability where reliable. Unavailable values remain unknown.
privacyDetails.logs.title: Diagnostic logs
privacyDetails.logs.body: Short predefined technical steps may accompany errors: screen opened, request started, cache hit or synchronization failed. Passwords, tokens, grades and personal text are excluded.
privacyDetails.excluded.title: What we do not send to Crashlytics
privacyDetails.excluded.body: No passwords, access/refresh tokens, authorization headers, cookies, API secrets or register credentials. No usernames, email addresses, names, student/teacher/account IDs, school names or exact classes. No grades/averages, homework text, absence reasons, health information, absence notes, private notes, search text or notification contents. No API request/response payloads, raw URLs or personal URL parameters. No advertising identifiers, precise location, Wi-Fi names or IP collection implemented by us.
privacyDetails.analytics.title: Usage analytics
privacyDetails.analytics.body: The app adds predefined screens, feature opens and actions, login and load/cache results, data sources, sync, filters, semester, language and theme. Errors and durations are categories. Properties: internal school ID, provider category, demo mode, language, theme, academic year and known build/release category. No text inputs or register content.
privacyDetails.control.title: Changing settings
privacyDetails.control.body: Change separate choices and age eligibility in Settings > Privacy & Data. Information pages and Customize do not save consent. Only a confirmed choice is saved.
privacyDetails.limits.title: Withdrawal and platforms
privacyDetails.limits.body: Withdrawal blocks new optional diagnostics, disables Firebase collection and deletes locally unsent crash reports. It does not delete records already uploaded to Firebase. Windows and Linux use no Firebase diagnostic/analytics collection. Firebase may use technical installation/session identifiers, which are not school account identifiers.
privacySettings.allow: Allow optional diagnostics and usage data
privacyCategory.diagnostics.title: Error diagnostics
privacyCategory.diagnostics.body: Technical crash and error data help us find problems in the app.
privacyCategory.usage.title: Usage analytics
privacyCategory.usage.body: Pseudonymous usage data show which features are used. An internal school ID can associate the school.
privacyCategory.academic.title: School & grade statistics
privacyCategory.academic.body: In addition to usage analytics: locally calculated overall grade average to one decimal and count buckets for aggregate statistics. No individual grades or register content.
privacyAge.title: Age eligibility
privacyAge.question: Are you at least 14 years old?
privacyAge.resolve: Resolve age eligibility to choose optional purposes.
privacyAge.under14Explanation: Optional data processing for users under 14 requires parental consent. Because there is no verified parental consent flow, optional data remain disabled.
privacyDetails.identity.title: Pseudonymous identity
privacyDetails.identity.body: With usage analytics the app uses a random identifier per locally saved account and installation. It contains no name, email or credentials. It groups usage and reduces repeated counting. The same person on multiple devices can be counted more than once. These data are pseudonymous, not anonymous.
privacyDetails.school.title: School association
privacyDetails.school.body: With usage analytics the selected school may be sent as an internal ID such as school_0037. The school name is not sent as an Analytics property. Demo data are not associated with a real school.
privacyDetails.academic.title: Pseudonymous school and performance statistics
privacyDetails.academic.body: Only with additional consent: overall average calculated locally as in the app and rounded to one decimal, academic year, semester and grade/subject count buckets. The contribution is linked to your pseudonymous identifier and internal school ID. No individual grades, subject names or averages, teachers, comments or attendance data. Demo data are excluded. The purpose is aggregate averages; school groups may only be published with at least 30 distinct pseudonymous identifiers. Changes can produce new contributions.
privacyDetails.analyticsAutomatic.title: Automatic technical Analytics data
privacyDetails.analyticsAutomatic.body: After consent Firebase also collects its own technical usage information, such as sessions, app version, OS, device category/model and engagement. Details depend on platform and SDK. Automatic screen reporting and advertising ID collection remain disabled. Firebase adds event timestamps; the app adds no precise timestamps.
privacyDetails.age.title: Age eligibility
privacyDetails.age.body: We store only locally: unknown, at least 14 or under 14. No birth date, birth year or exact age. This state is never sent to Firebase, servers or logs. Optional telemetry stays disabled under 14. You can reopen the decision in Settings; this does not automatically grant consent.
privacyDetails.revocation.title: Revocation
privacyDetails.revocation.body: Revocation stops future optional collection on this device. When usage analytics is revoked we clear the Analytics identity and app properties in the SDK and reset local Analytics data. Data already processed or uploaded are not automatically erased on the server. This app has no automatic server-side deletion workflow.
privacyDetails.analyticsExcluded.title: What we never send to Analytics
privacyDetails.analyticsExcluded.body: No passwords, access/refresh tokens, session cookies, authorization headers, usernames, emails, real names, student/teacher names or school account IDs. No exact class/section, individual grades, subject names or averages, homework text, messages, absence reasons, sickness/health information, free-text notes or search text. No API request/response bodies, raw URLs with IDs/parameters, notification text, precise GPS location, Wi-Fi SSID/BSSID or advertising ID added by the app. Only with additional consent may the reduced overall average be sent as academic statistics.
